items.platform_meaning: A platform value is accepted only when, lower-cased with surrounding spaces stripped, it reads blackdiamond or black diamond. The check is a constant comparison and reads no column, and any other non-null value is refused platform_not_source_label.
items.omit_means: When platform is omitted the check returns at once with no label filter, and the allocation is read for the account as if the argument were not sent.

refusals.when: a non-null platform whose stripped lower-cased text is neither blackdiamond nor black diamond

items.platform_meaning: A platform value must equal a Custodian value present in the newest fact_allocations partition, and also one of the Custodian values of this account's own allocation rows. The match is exact and case-sensitive. Otherwise it is refused platform_not_source_label, and the value is used for nothing else on this path.
items.omit_means: When platform is omitted no label check runs and the account's model assignment and target weights are read from the newest partitions of each table.

refusals.when: a non-null platform that is not a Custodian value of the partition or of this account's allocation rows

items.platform_meaning: The only accepted platform value is the constant commonwealth, compared lower-cased to the adapter's PLATFORM_LABEL. Any other non-null value is refused platform_not_source_label before the account reference is read, and no label is read from data.
items.omit_means: When platform is omitted the call goes on after the account reference parses and refuses no_allocation_source with no read, since the closed delivery has no allocation table.

refusals.when: a non-null platform whose lower-cased text is not commonwealth

items.platform_meaning: The platform argument is never read on this path, so no value of platform is refused platform_not_source_label. With no model key the call refuses account_not_resolved first, and with a model key it returns the model allocation, which carries no custodian label.
